```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
})

# ===============================
# Input and output directories
# ===============================
CNV_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/CNV_PCGR/CNV"
OUT_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/CNV_PCGR/Plot"

dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ===============================
# Find CSV files
# ===============================
files <- sort(list.files(CNV_DIR, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE))

cat("[INFO] CNV input directory:", CNV_DIR, "\n")
cat("[INFO] Output directory:", OUT_DIR, "\n")
cat("[INFO] CSV files found:", length(files), "\n\n")

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("[ERROR] No CSV files found in CNV_DIR.")
}

# ===============================
# Create file map
# Strip _Tier1 (Strong_clinical_significance) / _Tier2 (Potential_clinical_significance) to get base sample name
# ===============================
file_map <- tibble(
  file_path = files,
  file_name = basename(files),
  file_stem = str_remove(file_name, "\\.csv$")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Source_Tier = case_when(
      str_detect(file_stem, "_Tier1$") ~ "Tier1",
      str_detect(file_stem, "_Tier2$") ~ "Tier2",
      TRUE ~ "Main"
    ),
    Sample = str_remove(file_stem, "_Tier[0-9]+$")
  )

cat("====================================================\n")
cat("[INFO] Files grouped by sample\n")
cat("====================================================\n")

group_summary <- file_map %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    n_files = n(),
    files = paste(file_name, collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(group_summary)

write_csv(
  group_summary,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "CNV_file_grouping_summary.csv")
)

# ===============================
# Function to read one CNV CSV file
# ===============================
read_cnv_file <- function(f, sample, source_tier, file_name) {

  df <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "unique")

  # Drop first blank column if present
  # Your header starts with: "","SYMBOL","GENENAME",...
  if (ncol(df) > 0 && names(df)[1] %in% c("", "...1", "X1")) {
    df <- df %>% select(-1)
  }

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Sample = sample,
      Source_Tier = source_tier,
      Source_File = file_name,
      .before = 1
    )

  return(df)
}

# ===============================
# Merge files for one sample
# No deduplication
# ===============================
merge_one_sample <- function(sample_name, sample_files) {

  cat("\n[INFO] Merging sample:", sample_name, "\n")
  cat("[INFO] Number of files:", nrow(sample_files), "\n")
  cat("[INFO] Files:", paste(sample_files$file_name, collapse = ", "), "\n")

  combined <- pmap_dfr(
    list(
      sample_files$file_path,
      sample_files$Sample,
      sample_files$Source_Tier,
      sample_files$file_name
    ),
    read_cnv_file
  )

  out_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(sample_name, ".csv"))

  write_csv(combined, out_file)

  cat("[INFO] Total rows merged:", nrow(combined), "\n")
  cat("[DONE] Saved:", out_file, "\n")

  tibble(
    Sample = sample_name,
    n_input_files = nrow(sample_files),
    input_files = paste(sample_files$file_name, collapse = "; "),
    total_rows_merged = nrow(combined),
    output_file = out_file
  )
}

# ===============================
# Run merge per sample
# ===============================
merge_summary <- file_map %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map_dfr(~ merge_one_sample(unique(.x$Sample), .x))

# ===============================
# Save final summary
# ===============================
summary_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "CNV_merge_summary.csv")
write_csv(merge_summary, summary_file)

cat("\n====================================================\n")
cat("[DONE] All sample-level CNV files created without deduplication\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
cat("[INFO] Total samples:", nrow(merge_summary), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Summary saved:", summary_file, "\n")
```
